title: Indexing a concatenated program
statement: Let $P_0$, $B$, and $R$ be finite lists of statements, and let $i$ be a natural number. If the entry at index $i$ of $B$ is a statement $b$, then the entry at index $|P_0|+i$ of the concatenated list $P_0\mathbin{++}B\mathbin{++}R$ is $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The entry at index $i$ of $B$ is the statement $b$
